summary: Customer wants to investigate spectroscopy for tracking protein concentration in a dairy whey stream before a concentration stage, using laboratory results as reference, with a first measurement concept that handles the stream becoming more turbid.

facts_stated.text: The application is a dairy process.
The measurement point is a whey stream before a concentration stage.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: whey stream before a concentration stage

facts_stated.text: The stream is relatively clear under at least some conditions.
The stream can become more turbid under some operating conditions.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: The stream can become more turbid under some operating conditions

facts_stated.text: Laboratory results are to be used as the reference.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: with laboratory results used as the reference

targets.purpose: track concentration as the stream changes
assess whether spectroscopy can follow the changing stream

optical_regime.enquiry_quote: The stream can become more turbid under some operating conditions

process.enquiry_quote: a relatively clear whey stream before a concentration stage

customer_premises.claim: Spectroscopy may be suitable to track protein concentration in the changing whey stream.
customer_premises.enquiry_quote: whether spectroscopy can track protein concentration as the stream changes

customer_premises.claim: The stream is relatively clear under normal conditions but can become more turbid under some operating conditions.
customer_premises.enquiry_quote: The stream can become more turbid under some operating conditions

customer_premises.claim: A first measurement concept should handle turbidity changes without assuming the liquid always remains clear.
customer_premises.enquiry_quote: We need a first measurement concept that handles this change rather than assuming the liquid always remains clear
